{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-wv-class-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"c4e1ccf7b8ff658d5d3250bbfd1c1a84f5416778b95ad5a7854daba2c1d318ad","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-wv-class-e:lineage:2","source_registry_sha256":"2261abaab8e2b1aaff5b8a336e3bfcf845adaa75847f0210442061783d7f9afb","source_liveness_sha256":"9a1fb68777f5e9d5c4b27899084cc233b265410fee506dfe6554447a61ea026e"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Definitions","heading":"C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Definitions","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Definitions

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A02
A suspension withdraws the driver's license and driving privileges only temporarily, while a revocation terminates them so that the license cannot be renewed [A02].
Why it matters: group license-status; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F31, sec01-F35 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A02
An operator includes a person steering a vehicle that a motor vehicle is towing on a highway, not only the person driving the towing vehicle under power [A02].
Why it matters: group who-drives; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F11; confusables sec01-F11, sec01-F29 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
An acceleration lane serves drivers entering a high-speed highway, whereas a deceleration lane serves drivers leaving it [A01].
Why it matters: group lanes; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F01, sec01-F09 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A02
The roadway is only the portion of the highway used for vehicle travel, so the berm or shoulder belongs to the highway but not to the roadway [A02].
Why it matters: group highway-parts; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F17; confusables sec01-F17, sec01-F33 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A02
A moped is limited to two horsepower and fifty cubic centimeters, while a motor-driven cycle may carry a motor of up to two hundred fifty cubic centimeters and expressly excludes mopeds [A02].
Why it matters: group two-wheelers; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F25, sec01-F27 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A02
A motorcycle may travel on up to three wheels and a moped likewise has two or three wheels, so wheel count alone does not separate the two categories [A02].
Why it matters: group two-wheelers; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F25; confusables sec01-F25, sec01-F26 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A02
A school bus is defined by its purpose of carrying children to or from school and may be publicly or privately owned, which sets it apart from the general bus definition built on passenger count and compensation [A02].
Why it matters: group vehicle-categories; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F06; confusables sec01-F06, sec01-F34 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A01
The lower point zero two percent blood alcohol limit applies to drivers under the age of twenty-one, while the point zero eight percent limit applies to drivers over the age of twenty-one [A01].
Why it matters: group alcohol-limits; difficulty high; prereq sec01-F05; confusables sec01-F05, sec01-F13 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A01
A vehicle built for sixteen or more passengers counting the driver is a commercial motor vehicle, while the bus definition starts at more than seven passengers carried for compensation [A01].
Why it matters: group vehicle-categories; difficulty high; prereq sec01-F08; confusables sec01-F06, sec01-F08 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A02
An interchange links roadways on different levels through grade separations, whereas an intersection is simply the area where two or more highways meet at or near right angles [A02].
Why it matters: group highway-parts; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F20, sec01-F21 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A02
A modified golf cart or an ATV is not a low-speed vehicle, because the term covers only a four-wheeled vehicle designated as such on its manufacturer's certificate of origin [A02].
Why it matters: group vehicle-categories; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F22; confusables sec01-F22, sec01-F23 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A02
The implied consent law penalizes refusing the chemical test itself, with a suspension of the driving privilege for at least one year [A02].
Why it matters: group alcohol-limits; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F19; confusables sec01-F19, sec01-F35 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A01
A farm tractor is the motor vehicle that pulls plows and mowing machines, while an implement of husbandry is the agricultural vehicle or equipment itself that is designed or adapted for farm use [A01].
Why it matters: group vehicle-categories; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F14, sec01-F18 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]
